messages.subject: Re: Partial mediation in r (lavaan)
parts:
My direct and indirect effects are significant with good fit indices. But when I have added eudDecim (which is a significant interaction term) to my model to include a moderated relationship, I get the errors I mentioned in my previous post.

This is the syntax

pathmodel4.1 <- "engagement ~ psymean + eudaimonia + future + impulsec + decisionm + egoDep + b*intrin + c*hedonia
meaning ~ d1*eudaimonia + egoDep + b1*intrin + c1*hedonia + d2*decisionm + d3*eudDecim
psymean ~ eudaimonia + meaning + ident
impulsec ~ future + egoDep
decisionm ~ eudaimonia + future
eudaimonia ~ egoDep + future 
ident ~ eudaimonia + engagement
intrin ~ a*hedonia + engagement + eudaimonia


indirect1 := a*b
indirect2 := a*b1
total := c1 + (a*b) + (a*b1)

## Covariances
eudaimonia ~~ hedonia
impulsec ~~ decisionm
intrin ~~ ident
eudDecim ~~ engagement + meaning + psymean + impulsec + ident + intrin
"

fit4.1 <- sem(pathmodel4.1, data = allfactors, fixed.x = FALSE)
summary(fit4.1, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

I have three other moderators but trying to add one at a time!

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Partial mediation in r (lavaan)
parts:
Alykell,
  I do not think that you have provided enough information to pinpoint the problem.  However, as I understand it, the problem is that Lavaan is reporting that the interaction term is not in your data set.  You can test this with the str(...) function before you run Lavaan, by replacing ... with the name of your data frame.  Is it possible that you are adding the variable in one place but then feeding Lavaan the data from another?

Keith
